description: This file contains a class AzureAssistantsAPI that provides methods to interact with Azure OpenAI's assistant, message, thread, and run functionalities. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations for managing assistants, creating threads, adding messages, and executing threads with streaming capabilities.
